payout_quote: Adobe Creative Cloud Pro for students and teachers. (Adobe's published student terms: US$19.99/month for the first year on the annual plan, billed monthly — roughly 60% off the standard price; price rises after the first year.)
timing: Discounted rate applies from signup after eligibility verification; billed monthly on the annual plan.
eligibility: Students and teachers 13+ enrolled in an accredited public/private university or college, primary or secondary school, or homeschool under state regulations; verified at purchase via school-issued email or documents (student ID, report card, transcript, tuition bill with name, institution, and current date).
catches: This is a discount on a paid subscription, not cash — it costs you $19.99/month; it never pays you.
The first-year price is promotional — the rate rises after year one (Adobe's published second-year student rate is higher).
Annual plan with commitment — early cancellation triggers an early termination fee.
Eligibility is re-verified; if you stop being a student you lose the rate.

weasel_words.quote: The '$19' route figure implies a benefit amount, but the official program is a ~60% discount on a subscription you pay for — it is a cost, not a payout.

steps: Choose the Creative Cloud Pro students-and-teachers plan (annual billed monthly, US$19.99/month first year per Adobe's published terms).
Create or sign in to your Adobe account.
Verify your student/teacher eligibility via your school-issued email or by uploading documents (school ID, report card, transcript, or tuition bill showing name, institution, and current date).
Complete purchase — the discounted rate applies from signup; note the renewal date and the higher second-year rate before subscribing.
biggest_catch: This costs money — $19.99/month for a subscription. It's a discount, not earnings; the route figure '$19' is the price you pay, not money you make.
